title: Security & encryption
intro: End-to-end encrypt sensitive fields (notes, names) with a passphrase only you know. We store only the encrypted form — support can never read it without your explicit, time-limited consent.
setupNoteBold: Choose a passphrase you won't forget.
setupNoteMid: It never leaves your device, so we can't reset or recover it. You'll get a one-time recovery code as backup — if you lose
setupNoteEnd: , your encrypted data can't be recovered by anyone, including support.
alreadySetUp: Encryption is already set up on this account. Unlock it instead — setting it up again would make your existing notes unreadable.
recoveryHint: Store it somewhere safe — a password manager or written down offline. We can't show it again.
recoveryWarnTitle: ⚠︎ There is no other way back in
recoveryWarnOne: Your passphrase and this recovery code are the
recoveryWarnTwo: to your encrypted fields. If you
recoveryWarnForget: forget the passphrase AND lose this code
recoveryWarnFive: . We never see your passphrase or your keys, so there is nothing we can reset or restore. Please save the code before continuing.
unlockIntro: Encryption is on. Unlock to read and write protected fields on this device.
unlockedStatus: ● Unlocked — protected fields are readable on this device.
supportBodyOne: Lets our support team help you for
supportBodyTwo: , then it expires automatically. Structural access only checks for sync problems (no data is read). Content access lets support decrypt your fields to debug — every access is logged.
notSetUp: Encryption is not set up on this account.
unlockForContent: Unlock encryption first to share content access.
supportNotConfigured: Support access is not configured for this deployment.
unlockToAuthorize: Unlock encryption to authorize support access.
lockedNoteHint: Unlock encryption to read or edit this note.
